notes: This contract pins the private Annex C.5 synchronization-point composition rule. Same-label synchronization points are compared with the first definition: an identical duplicate is ignored, while any differing label/data type/capability/semantics/note sub-element fails composition. Referenced notes are compared by note content after Umbra's per-module label remapping, so semantically identical modules remain equivalent. This is source/test traceability only, not a public synchronization-service or conformance claim.
